exposure: age at time of index MUS placement
concomitant apical prolapse repair during index MUS procedure
cohort: Women who underwent mid-urethral sling (MUS) placement
finding: Younger age at MUS placement, increasing number of cesarean deliveries, and concomitant apical prolapse repair were independent predictors of sling revision.
mod_finding: Increasing number of cesarean deliveries was a significant predictor of mid-urethral sling revision surgery.
